title: Multimodal datasets: misogyny, pornography, and malignant stereotypes
findings: Querying the LAION-400M dataset for the religious term 'Nun' resulted in 16.4% of matches containing NSFW-related terms in their text or URL, indicating a significant presence of problematic and sexualized content associated with this religious role.

measurement_description: Stereotype detection and association with problematic (NSFW) content for the religious term 'Nun' in a large-scale multimodal dataset (LAION-400M). The analysis measured the prevalence of NSFW terms in the text and URLs associated with images retrieved for this query.
